lessons: The English file cited 'Section 14G' for the remote-purchase cooling-off period while the Hebrew file already said 14ג. Transliteration trap: ג is the third letter, so 14ג is 14C; 14ז (14G) is credit vouchers. Check both language files independently when auditing section numbers.

The 6-minute phone rule is in the Consumer Protection LAW (s.18B(a1)), not in the 2012 Telephone Service Regulations, and the two files named two DIFFERENT wrong instruments. It binds only Second-Schedule sectors, so most Israeli SMEs are not covered at all.
